description: WO-005 coverage evidence. `mappings` are explicit check-to-tool entries; only these can raise a tool above registration-only, and only when scripts/coverage_report.py finds the check obeys the promotion rules. `registration_only` records explicit reasons. `flags` are availability flags. `run_evidence` holds recorded observations and never contributes to source coverage. Mapping method: a check is attributed only when exactly one tool is invoked between the previous success record and it in the same function; records in exception handlers or early-return branches are not mapped; checks whose assertion is only a self-reported status or result type are mapped as defined-execution.

mappings.label: Search finds the tag it just wrote
mappings.assertion: any(asset_path in str(h) for h in hits)

mappings.label: Search no longer finds it after removal
mappings.assertion: not any(asset_path in str(h) for h in gone_hits)

mappings.label: Color Harmony
mappings.assertion:
r.get("status") == "ok" and r.get("count") == r.get("attempted") == 3
                and r.get("harmony") == "triadic"

mappings.label: Bulk Swap reports a miss as error
Organize Assets
mappings.assertion:
preview.get("dry_run") is True and preview.get("moved") == 0
                    and moved.get("moved", 0) > 0

mappings.label: mark_selection status matches the count
mappings.assertion:
(st == "ok" and changed and not failed)
            or (st == "partial" and changed and failed)
            or (st == "error" and not changed and failed)
mappings.basis: accepts a documented refusal as well as success; the check fails on any other result

mappings.label: mark_selection(False) status matches the count
mappings.assertion:
(c_st == "ok" and c_changed and not c_failed)
            or (c_st == "partial" and c_changed and c_failed)
            or (c_st == "error" and not c_changed and c_failed)
mappings.basis: accepts a documented refusal as well as success; the check fails on any other result

mappings.label: returned path exists on disk
mappings.basis: checks that the asset path curve_create returned exists, via unreal.EditorAssetLibrary.does_asset_exist; a reading of the check's source, not evidence from a fresh run

mappings.label: Export Manifest
mappings.assertion: out_path is not None and os.path.exists(out_path)

mappings.label: Spawn Kit
mappings.assertion: (status == "ok" and count > 0) or (status in ("error", "partial") and count < spawned.get("requested", 0))
mappings.basis: accepts a documented refusal as well as success; the check fails on any other result

mappings.label: Select in Radius
mappings.assertion: a1 in selected and a2 in selected and a3 not in selected

mappings.label: stamp_save
mappings.assertion:
isinstance(result, dict) and result.get("status") == "ok"
                  and saved == len(actors)

mappings.label: stamp_place
mappings.assertion:
isinstance(result, dict) and result.get("status") == "ok"
                   and stamped == total and stamped

mappings.label: actor_folder_list
mappings.assertion:
isinstance(result, dict) and result.get("status") == "ok"
                   and "TOOLBELT_TEST_OrgFolder" in folders

mappings.label: actor_duplicate_offset
mappings.assertion:
isinstance(result, dict) and result.get("status") == "ok"
                   and spawned == 2

mappings.label: actor_copy_to_positions
mappings.assertion:
isinstance(result, dict) and result.get("status") == "ok"
                   and spawned == 2

mappings.label: align_to_surface
mappings.assertion:
isinstance(result, dict) and (
            result.get("status") == "ok"
            or result.get("reason") == "engine_api_unavailable"
        )
mappings.basis: accepts self-reported success or the documented engine_api_unavailable refusal; it does not check the resulting alignment

mappings.label: world_settings_set (gravity)
mappings.assertion:
(status == "ok" and result.get("applied", {}).get("gravity") == -980.0)
            or (status == "error"
                and result.get("reason") == "properties_not_exposed"
                and "gravity" in result.get("unavailable", {}))
mappings.basis: accepts a documented refusal as well as success; the check fails on any other result

mappings.label: level_health_report
mappings.assertion:
isinstance(result, dict) and result.get("status") == "ok"
                  and "score" in result

mappings.label: config_get
mappings.assertion:
isinstance(result, dict) and result.get("status") == "ok"
                  and result.get("value") == "TOOLBELT_TEST_Config"

mappings.label: world_state_export
mappings.assertion:
isinstance(result, dict) and result.get("status") == "ok"
                  and result.get("count", 0) > 0

flags.reason: Mesh reduction crashes UEFN (Quirk #18), so the operation is stubbed; it calls `_apply_lods` directly
flags.enforcement: Code only: `_apply_lods` never calls the crashing reduction API (`set_lods_with_notification`); it logs an error and reports the mesh as failed. There is no registry-level disabling: the tool stays registered, callable, and reachable from the dashboard, and the folder tools return status ok with the meshes counted as failed.
